notes.title: Global Update 20.03.25
notes.content:
What's new:
- Added weapons and a weapon upgrade system, customize your own
gun for the genocide of evil spirits.
- Added body armor, they are designed to cover your back.
- Added inventory and item storage, you will have to bother with choosing the equipment you need at the moment.
- Added a merchant, he loves money very much... And vegetables... And fish... And everything that you bring him.
- Added a farming system, grow vegetables and sell them,
to earn money for equipment.
- Added fishing, catch fish to earn money for equipment.
- Added new types of monsters, they also drop items, send them all to the underworld.
- Added saving of all progress, no longer worry about losing all your accumulated wealth.
- The world has been enlarged, new locations have been added, now there are even more picturesque and gloomy places.
(You may feel the loading effect in the first seconds of the game)
- Improved optimization.
- Added Chinese Simplified language.

The price remains the same for now. Despite the situation in our country, we are not stopping development. 
A lot of groundwork has been laid for new content for you, we value each of our players, and we want to express our gratitude for the expectations. 
If you notice a bug or error, write to us in the community.

notes.title: The decline of the old - the rise of the new
notes.content:
Creeper Nightmare is officially closed. The product did not cause the expected reaction, so we decided to close the project. 
BUT... We can't leave those players who have been with us from day one empty-handed, so "Raven Tear" comes to replace "Creeper Nightmare".

Raven Tear is a stylized co-op adventure (4 players) in a small open world with horror elements. Evil has gripped the small town of "Raven Tear", you - brave hunters, must take your faithful dog and your excellent car, turn up the radio louder to travel through the locations and drive them all back to the underworld. Get into the car, choose your path - and go ahead to meet adventures.

We are also already working on the next update, which you will see on February 9, 2025, where new content will be waiting for you:

- Search and capture of monsters.
The monster will no longer wander around waiting for its victims, now you will need to make efforts using otherworldly detection devices to find the zone of its anomaly and force itself to show itself in all its glory. It will also be your task to trap him before banishing him to hell. You just need to remain quiet - because the monster will hear you and understand what you are talking about.

- Improved ride sensations.
The mud of swamps, the grass of dense forests, smooth asphalt - all this will be felt well when you are driving your car.

- More dynamic weather.
Cold nights, rainy days or foggy dawns - you will have to experience it first hand.

- VR support.
You can enjoy your adventures in a stylized world in virtual reality.

- Living world.
A deer crossing the road, an alligator indicating to you that you are clearly lost - the world will come to life in new colors with animals.

- Living world.
A deer crossing the road, an alligator indicating to you that you are clearly lost - the world will come to life in new colors with animals.

- Team fun.
Play poker with friends, train your "Boomer" on the training ground, or compete for the title of the best driver on the race track for the fastest time.

-Voice chat.
Chat with friends using voice input without being distracted from the game.

-Steam achievements. If you want everyone to see your success in Raven Tear, it will be done.

-More music. Changing the radio station, different genres of music, as well as a portable boombox - all this will be available.

We also announce that with the release of this update the price will increase to $11.99. Now you can support us by sharing the game with your friends and leaving your review.

Noticed an error, bug, strange events? Write to us about this under the post, everything will be corrected as soon as possible.

notes.title: Global Update - Part 2
notes.content:
While we finish work on the second patch before the last update - we have everything ready to work on the second part of the global update.
Meet one of the important characters of the series, come face to face with new stages of a stronger monster. In the second part of the global update, you will find: a new trade function, save progress, skirmishes with new stages of the enemy, and some other surprises.

We are happy to update and add content for you for free, but now we are asking for a little bit of your support. We value each and every one of our players, and thanks to the discount we have even more, but a very small percentage of players leave feedback - which is very important for the development of early developers. So we kindly ask everyone who has purchased or is just about to purchase the game to just go in and leave a review, for you it's a minute of business, for us it's a chance for further development. So don't be lazy, support us - and we will continue to try for you...

notes.title: Global update
notes.content:
We are very grateful to all of you who are waiting for our updates. We are very sorry that you saw a bad technical condition on the release, and due to a lack of resources, we need some time to fix everything. And while you are waiting for all the errors to be corrected - we decided to make a global content update as a thank you for waiting. We expand, add, and reimagine story scenes so you can see a more detailed picture of what's going on. You will also find hints for future changes in the game.
Thank you to each of you for waiting patiently, we appreciate each and every one of you. Write your wishes and suggestions, we try to listen to each of you to improve our content.
